identity description: An instant cup noodle cup. Tapered cream paper cup with a bold wavy red stripe band around it, the round paper lid peeled halfway back and curling up, a tangle of golden yellow noodles with a few green onion bits visible inside, a pair of wooden chopsticks resting diagonally across the rim.

A Japanese triangular rice ball (onigiri) with rounded corners, plump white rice body with a few simple grain bumps on the outline, a small bite taken out of the top right corner, a dark green nori seaweed sheet wrapped across the bottom half.

A standing soda can, leaf green top and bottom bands with a wide cream middle band covered in small round blue polka dots, a silver ring-pull tab opened on top, two or three tiny round fizz bubbles popping above the opening.
A tapered popcorn box with vertical red and cream stripes, overflowing with a heaped dome of fluffy cream-yellow popcorn kernels, one or two kernels tumbling off the side of the box.

An open kraft-paper takeout box with its flaps folded out, holding five plump pleated steamed dumplings (soup dumplings with twisted tops) on a sheet of parchment, one empty spot where a dumpling was eaten.

A small glass milk bottle of pastel pink strawberry milk, a cream cloth cap tied with a red ribbon bow at the neck, a red-and-white striped bent straw poking out, a single red strawberry with a green leaf shown as a flat label on the front.

A round terracotta clay hot pot with two small side handles, its lid tilted open and resting at an angle on the rim, a bubbling stew inside with tofu cubes, mushrooms and green onions, two simple cream steam curls drawn as solid outlined shapes rising above.

A wobbly golden custard pudding on a small shallow cream dish, the top of the pudding shaped like a smooth crescent moon, glossy amber caramel sauce dripping down the sides, a tiny pale yellow star-shaped sparkle near the moon tip.
